entities.summary:
Alexon was an ancient Greek mercenary from Achaea, who served in the Carthaginian garrison at Lilybaeum while it was besieged by the Romans in 250 BC, during the First Punic War.



Alexon saved the town of Agrigentum from a similar attempt by treacherous mercenaries and alerted the Carthaginian commander Himilco to the plot, thwarting the betrayal.



This event showcases Alexon's bravery, strategic thinking, and loyalty to the Carthaginian cause, highlighting the complexities of ancient Mediterranean politics and warfare.



Alexon's actions also demonstrate the evolving nature of military alliances and the impact of mercenary armies on the outcome of conflicts.



Through his heroic actions, Alexon left a lasting legacy in the annals of ancient history, serving as a testament to the enduring power of human courage and ingenuity in the face of overwhelming odds.
